services.name: 20' Car Hauler - From $65
services.desc: Our 20' Car Hauler Trailer is set up for loading and hauling vehicles from small cars to full size crew cab trucks. Maximum load weight is 7,000lbs. Full Width vehicles will fit, and our drive-over style fenders can handle your rock crawler tires. Slide in 5' ramps allow easy loading, and a winch option is available for advance reservations (please call ahead). Hitch requires a 2 5/16" tow ball. Your tow vehicle must be equipped with a trailer brake controller to rent the trailer. Damage deposit of $500 is required upon
